name: Highly Casual | 50mg Seltzer | Haha Blast
description: Ride the tropical wave with Haha Blast! Exploding with a bold, refreshing surge of tropical fruits, this soda delivers that deeply satisfying, crisp carbonation you crave and might even taste a little familiar. It’s sweet, it’s nostalgic, and it packs a serious punch. Infused with 50mg of premium Nano THC for a rapid-onset, hangover-free buzz, Haha Blast is built for maximum chill, big laughs and your favorite late night tacos. Crack one open, find your paradise, and let the good times roll!
